title: The Repeated Drafting Error
brief: In 4 of the last 10 Meridian Advisory client reports, the executive summary figures did not match the body tables. Each was corrected after the client noticed. Action CA-12 says "authors to proofread more carefully". You have 12 visit points to reach a system cause.

evidence.text: CA-12 cause "careless proofreading", action "proofread more carefully", closed without check; 2 errors since.
evidence.whyItMatters: Corrective action must remove the cause and be checked.

evidence.text: Error records ER-1 to ER-4: all 4 errors followed late changes to body tables after the summary was written.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look for what the errors share.

evidence.text: Author: "I write the summary first, then the tables get updated."
Template T-6 has summary figures typed by hand, not linked to tables.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask how figures reach the summary.

evidence.text: Peer review checklist PR-2 has no item for summary-to-table consistency.
Reviewer: "I check method and conclusions as the checklist asks."
Late changes log shows table edits after peer review in 3 of 4 cases, with no re-review (log LC-1).

decisions.prompt: Which statement best describes the system cause?
options: Summary figures are typed by hand, tables change after review without re-review, and the checklist does not check consistency
decisions.rationale: The cause is in the template, workflow, and review.

containment: Check summary-to-table consistency on all reports in progress
cause: Hand-typed summaries, unreviewed late changes, and no consistency check
corrective: Link summary figures to tables, require re-review after late changes, and add a consistency item to PR-2
effectiveness: Track consistency errors over the next twenty reports

debriefText.found: You moved from proofreading to template and workflow.
debriefText.falseFinding: Workload and coffee were not causes.
